equipmentSummary: Equipment categories typical of a large budget commercial gym chain: pin-loaded (selectorised) machines, plate-loaded machines, multiple squat racks, dumbbells up to about 60kg, straight and EZ barbells, benches, cable stations, kettlebells, bands, plyo boxes and a functional area. Specific machines vary by club, so the app treats every exercise as available until the lifter marks it unavailable at a club. lowerBackLoad: chest-supported, seated and bench-supported options are low; squats, overhead press, hip thrust, farmer's carry, loaded spinal flexion and back extension are moderate; bent-over row, deadlift and RDLs are high (hidden when lower-back protection is on). loadIncrementKg values are typical defaults, editable per equipment type.

exercises.name: Bench press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows, wrists. Keep shoulder blades set; use a rack with safety arms or a spotter.

exercises.name: Dumbbell bench press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Friendlier range of motion than a barbell. Dumbbells cap at 60kg each.

exercises.name: Dumbbell floor press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Triceps touch the floor, which limits shoulder range. Needs no bench, so it works when benches are busy.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated and supported.

exercises.name: Machine press (plate-loaded)
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Plate-loaded chest press; load each side evenly.

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows, wrists. Brace the core so the lower back does not sag. Hands on a bench to make it easier.

exercises.name: Incline barbell bench press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders (front delts), elbows. Needs an adjustable/incline bench or incline rack bench; bench type is not confirmed .

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Use a 30 degree bench angle. Needs an adjustable bench; type not confirmed .

exercises.name: Incline machine press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated and supported.

exercises.name: Pec deck
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulder front capsule; do not let the arms travel far behind the torso.

exercises.name: Cable fly
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders; keep a slight elbow bend fixed.

exercises.name: Dumbbell fly
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders (stretched position); keep the load light and the range controlled.

exercises.name: DB shoulder press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated with back support keeps the lower back out of it; standing is the fallback if no upright bench.

exercises.name: Machine shoulder press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated and supported.

exercises.name: Barbell overhead press
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows, wrists. Standing, so it can arch the lower back; brace hard or do it seated.

exercises.name: Dumbbell lateral raise
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders (side delt). Light loads; stop at shoulder height.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders. Constant tension through the range.

exercises.name: Lateral raise machine
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders.

exercises.name: Upright row (barbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Also called 'Up rows'. Shoulder impingement risk; use a wide grip and keep the elbows below shoulder height.

exercises.name: Upright row (cable)
exercises.jointNotes: Also called 'Up rows'. Shoulder impingement risk; keep the elbows at or below shoulder height.

exercises.name: Upright row (dumbbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Also called 'Up rows'. Shoulder impingement risk; keep the elbows at or below shoulder height.

exercises.name: Reverse pec deck
exercises.jointNotes: Rear delts, upper back. Chest-supported.

exercises.name: Rear delt pull (cable)
exercises.jointNotes: Also called 'Rear delt pulls'. Rear delts. Cables at shoulder height, pulling across or back.

exercises.name: Lying rear delt raise
exercises.jointNotes: Rear delts. Chest-supported face-down on an incline bench so the lower back stays unloaded; needs an adjustable bench (type not confirmed ). Light dumbbells.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.jointNotes: Rear delts, mid back. Arms straight at shoulder height, pull the band apart; a no-cable, no-bench fallback.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.jointNotes: Rear delts, rotator cuff, upper back. Good for shoulder health.

exercises.name: Triceps pushdown (cable)
exercises.jointNotes: Also called 'Triceps pulls'. Elbows. Keep the elbows pinned to the sides.

exercises.name: Triceps machine
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. Seated triceps extension or dip-style machine; confirm which type the club has.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. A good fallback when the cables are busy; progress by band thickness or reps.

exercises.name: Overhead dumbbell triceps extension
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, shoulders. Seated with back support if available.

exercises.name: Overhead cable triceps extension
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, shoulders.

exercises.name: EZ-bar skull crusher
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. Watch the elbow load; keep the weight moderate.

exercises.name: Close-grip bench press
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, wrists, shoulders. Shoulder-width grip, not narrower.

exercises.name: Parallel bar dips
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders (deep range is stressful), elbows. Limit depth.

exercises.name: Assisted dip machine
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Often the same station as the assisted pull-up.

exercises.name: EZ-bar curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, wrists (the EZ bar is easier on the wrists). Stand tall, no swinging.

exercises.name: Dumbbell curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, wrists.

exercises.name: Cable curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows.

exercises.name: Preacher curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows (strong stretch at the bottom). Do not drop into full extension with heavy loads. The EZ bar is confirmed but a preacher bench is not.

exercises.name: Bicep machine
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. Preacher-style curl machine.

exercises.name: Concentration curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. Seated, elbow braced against the inner thigh; a supported-curl fallback for the preacher.

exercises.name: Incline dumbbell curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, front of shoulders (stretched). Bench at about 45 to 60 degrees; needs an adjustable bench (type not confirmed ).

exercises.name: Bayesian cable curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, shoulder front. Single-arm, cable behind the body, so the biceps is stretched.

exercises.name: Drag curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows. The bar drags up the torso with the elbows moving back; use a light load.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, forearms. Neutral grip, easy on the wrists.

exercises.name: Rope hammer curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, forearms.

exercises.name: EZ-bar reverse curl
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, forearms (brachioradialis). Overhand grip; use a light load.

exercises.name: Chin-up
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, shoulders. Underhand grip; avoid swinging. Needs a pull-up bar or rig.

exercises.name: Pull-up
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Dead-hang start. Needs a pull-up bar or rig.

exercises.name: Assisted pull-up
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Less assistance weight means harder, so load progression runs in reverse.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Pull to the upper chest; avoid leaning far back.

exercises.name: Underhand lat pulldown
exercises.jointNotes: Elbows, shoulders. Shoulder-width underhand grip; more biceps involvement.

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Kneeling, band anchored high on a rack; a lighter fallback when machines and bars are busy.

exercises.name: Straight-arm pulldown
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders. Slight hip hinge, braced core.

exercises.name: Dumbbell pullover
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders (deep stretch). Keep the load moderate and the lower back flat on the bench.

exercises.name: Band straight-arm pulldown
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders. Anchor the band high on a rack.

exercises.name: Chest-supported row (machine)
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Chest pad takes the load off the lower back. May be pin-loaded or plate-loaded at the club.

exercises.name: Incline bench chest-supported row (dumbbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Lie chest-down on an incline bench; substitute for the machine. Needs an adjustable bench (type not confirmed ).

exercises.name: Dumbbell row
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. One knee and hand on a bench to support the back.

exercises.name: Row machine
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated with chest pad.

exercises.name: Cable row
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Seated; do not rock the torso back and forth.

exercises.name: Inverted row (barbell in rack)
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, elbows. Bar set at hip to chest height in a rack, body straight; bend the knees to make it easier. Lower back is braced, not loaded.

exercises.name: Barbell bent-over row
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back (isometric load), shoulders, elbows. Hidden when lower-back protection is on; use a supported row instead.

exercises.name: Dumbbell shrug
exercises.jointNotes: Neck, upper traps. Heavy dumbbells strain the grip (max 60kg).

exercises.name: Barbell shrug
exercises.jointNotes: Neck, upper traps. Can be done from a rack.

exercises.name: Smith machine shrug
exercises.jointNotes: Neck, upper traps. Smith machine not verified .

exercises.name: 45-degree back extension
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, hips. A hyperextension bench is mentioned in one member review (club unknown). Bodyweight only; stop at a neutral spine.

exercises.name: Conventional deadlift
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, hips, knees. Hidden when lower-back protection is on.

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, hamstrings, hips. Hidden when lower-back protection is on.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, hamstrings. Lighter than the barbell version but the same loaded hinge. Hidden when lower-back protection is on.

exercises.name: Cable pull-through
exercises.jointNotes: Hips, hamstrings, lower back (light). A gentler hinge pattern, but still a hinge; keep it light and the spine neutral.

exercises.name: Barbell back squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, lower back. Moderate when braced and upright, high when very heavy or fatigued. Use rack safety arms.

exercises.name: Front squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, wrists/shoulders (rack position), upper back. More upright torso than a back squat.

exercises.name: Smith machine squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Smith machine not verified . A fixed bar path reduces balance demands.

exercises.name: Goblet squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Light front load keeps the torso upright.

exercises.name: Kettlebell goblet squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Same as the dumbbell goblet squat; kettlebell weight range is not published .

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Do not let the pelvis tuck under at the bottom. Reviewers say the leg machines can max out for strong lifters.

exercises.name: Seated leg press
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Seated with back support. Stack may max out for strong lifters.

exercises.name: Hack squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Back is supported on the pad.

exercises.name: Smith machine feet-forward squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Feet ahead of the bar and back leaning on it, like a hack squat. Smith machine not verified .

exercises.name: Walking lunges
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, balance. Needs clear floor space; use reverse lunges if the floor is crowded.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge (dumbbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, balance. Steps back in place, so it needs less floor space and is easier on the knees than a forward lunge.

exercises.name: Bulgarian split squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, balance. Back foot on a bench.

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, balance. Onto a plyo box or bench; keep the box at or below knee height.

exercises.name: Smith machine split squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips. Smith machine not verified . Fixed path, so it is more stable.

exercises.name: Bodyweight lunge
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hips, balance.

exercises.name: Leg extensions
exercises.jointNotes: Knees (shear at the top of the range). Control the lowering.

exercises.name: Sissy squat
exercises.jointNotes: Knees (high stress), ankles. Advanced. Hold a rack upright for support; use a partial range first.

exercises.name: Banded terminal knee extension
exercises.jointNotes: Knees. Anchor the band at the back of the knee; a knee-friendly, light, rehab-level option, not an equal stimulus to the machine.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hamstring attachments. Keep the hips down on the pad.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.jointNotes: Knees. Seated with back support.

exercises.name: Cable standing leg curl
exercises.jointNotes: Knees. Ankle strap on a low cable; single leg.

exercises.name: Sliding hamstring curl
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hamstrings. Lie on the back, heels on a towel or slider on the floor, bridge up and slide the heels in and out. Keep the hips high; no equipment beyond a towel.

exercises.name: Nordic curl
exercises.jointNotes: Knees, hamstrings (very demanding, advanced). Anchor the feet under a bar or with a partner; use the arms to catch.

exercises.name: Hip thrust (barbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Hips, lower back (can over-arch at the top). Finish with ribs down and a posterior pelvic tilt. Use a pad.

exercises.name: Dumbbell hip thrust
exercises.jointNotes: Hips. Dumbbell across the hips, upper back on a bench.

exercises.name: Hip thrust machine
exercises.jointNotes: Hips. Not confirmed .

exercises.name: Glute bridge
exercises.jointNotes: Hips. Floor-based; a good warm-up or home fallback.

exercises.name: Hip abductor machine (out)
exercises.jointNotes: Hips. Seated, legs pushed outward.

exercises.name: Cable hip abduction
exercises.jointNotes: Hips. Ankle strap; hold a rack for balance.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.jointNotes: Hips, knees (keep them from caving in). Band above the knees.

exercises.name: Hip adductor machine (in)
exercises.jointNotes: Hips, groin. Seated, legs pulled together; ease into the starting range.

exercises.name: Cable hip adduction
exercises.jointNotes: Hips, groin. Ankle strap; single leg.

exercises.name: Copenhagen plank
exercises.jointNotes: Adductors, groin, obliques. Advanced; groin strain risk. Top leg on a bench. Start with the short-lever version.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise machine
exercises.jointNotes: Ankles, Achilles. Full stretch, pause at the top.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise machine
exercises.jointNotes: Ankles, Achilles. Bent knee, so it emphasises the soleus rather than the gastrocnemius.

exercises.name: Leg press calf raise
exercises.jointNotes: Ankles, Achilles. Balls of the feet on the bottom of the sled plate, knees nearly straight; do not lock the knees. Only if a leg press exists.

exercises.name: Smith machine calf raise
exercises.jointNotes: Ankles, Achilles. Toes on a plate or step. Smith machine not verified .

exercises.name: Single-leg dumbbell calf raise
exercises.jointNotes: Ankles, Achilles. Standing on a step or plyo box, holding a rack for balance.

exercises.name: Forearm curl (dumbbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Wrists, forearms. Forearms rest on a bench with palms up.

exercises.name: Forearm curl (barbell)
exercises.jointNotes: Wrists, forearms. Light load; full range.

exercises.name: Forearm curl (cable)
exercises.jointNotes: Wrists, forearms.

exercises.name: Farmer's carry
exercises.jointNotes: Grip, forearms, trunk and lower back (static load). Stand tall; needs clear floor space. Kettlebells also work.

exercises.name: Dead hang
exercises.jointNotes: Grip, shoulders (a gentle decompression stretch). Timed hold of 20 to 40 seconds. Needs a pull-up bar or rig.

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise
exercises.jointNotes: Grip, shoulders, hip flexors. Curl the pelvis up and do not swing or arch. Needs a pull-up bar or rig; bend the knees to make it easier.

exercises.name: Captain's chair leg raise
exercises.jointNotes: Hip flexors, elbows. Back supported on the pad. Not confirmed .

exercises.name: Lying leg raise
exercises.jointNotes: Hip flexors, lower back (it can arch under load). Bend the knees and press the lower back into the floor.

exercises.name: Cable crunch
exercises.jointNotes: Loaded spine flexion, which can aggravate a sensitive lower back. Hips stay fixed; curl the ribs toward the pelvis; keep the load light.

exercises.name: Ab crunch machine
exercises.jointNotes: Loaded spine flexion, which can aggravate a sensitive lower back. Keep the load light and the range small.

exercises.name: Reverse crunch
exercises.jointNotes: Lower abs, hip flexors. Lying on the back, curl the pelvis off the floor with control; do not swing the legs.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, lower back (stability). Timed hold of 20 to 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Side plank
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, obliques, hips. Timed hold of 15 to 45 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Pallof press (cable)
exercises.jointNotes: Trunk (anti-rotation). Low-load; a good option for lower back control.

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
exercises.jointNotes: Trunk (anti-rotation). Band anchored at chest height on a rack; the no-cable version of the Pallof press.

exercises.name: Chin tucks
exercises.jointNotes: Neck (cervical spine). Timed hold of 5 seconds for 10 reps, or 30 seconds in total.

exercises.name: Neck rotations
exercises.jointNotes: Neck. Slow and pain-free, 30 seconds in total (each side, with a pause at the end range).

exercises.name: Neck side stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Neck, upper traps. Timed hold of 30 seconds each side; no pulling on the head.

exercises.name: Cat-cow
exercises.jointNotes: Lumbar and thoracic spine. 10 slow reps or a 45 second timed set.

exercises.name: Child's pose
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, lats, hips. Timed hold of 30 to 60 seconds.

exercises.name: Pelvic tilt
exercises.jointNotes: Lumbar spine, deep abdominals. Lying on the back with knees bent, flatten and release the lower back; 10 slow reps or 30 seconds.

exercises.name: Knee-to-chest stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back, glutes, hips. Lying on the back, hug one knee in; timed hold of 20 to 30 seconds per side. Ease off if it pinches.

exercises.name: Bird-dog
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back stability, hips, shoulders. Hold 5 to 10 seconds per rep, 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Dead bug
exercises.jointNotes: Lower back and trunk control. Lower back stays flat on the floor; 30 to 45 seconds.

exercises.name: 90/90 hip stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Hip internal and external rotation, knees. Timed hold of 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Half-kneeling hip flexor stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Hip flexors, quads. Squeeze the glute and keep the ribs down. Timed hold of 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Figure-four stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Glutes, hip external rotators. Lying on the back. Timed hold of 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Wall kicks
exercises.jointNotes: Hip flexors and hamstrings (dynamic). Hand on a wall for balance; 10 to 15 controlled swings per side.

exercises.name: High kicks
exercises.jointNotes: Hamstrings, hip flexors (dynamic). Keep a controlled range; stop short of lower-back rounding.

exercises.name: Leg swings
exercises.jointNotes: Hips (dynamic). Front-to-back and side-to-side; 10 to 15 reps per leg.

exercises.name: Thread the needle
exercises.jointNotes: Thoracic spine, shoulders. Timed hold of 20 to 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Doorway pec stretch
exercises.jointNotes: Chest, front of shoulders. Use a rack upright or a wall. Timed hold of 30 seconds per side.

exercises.name: Wall slides
exercises.jointNotes: Shoulders, scapular control, thoracic spine. Back flat on the wall. 10 slow reps or a 45 second set.
